# Hamid Hair Studio — سالن تخصصی مو حامد عباسی

## About
Premium hair salon in Tehran, Iran. Run by Hamid Abbasi (حامد عباسی), a hair artist with 10+ years of experience serving both men and women.

## Services
- Men: Classic haircut, Fade, Beard trim, Hair color, Full grooming
- Women: Haircut, Hair color & highlights (Balayage), Keratin treatment, Styling, Hair braiding

## Booking
Customers can book appointments online through the app. The system shows real-time availability based on working hours, breaks, and existing bookings.
